scope: Issue24 D0 released-result atlas only; no model execution or D1
metric: released AUC-PR; audited TSB reference metric_PR uses average_precision_score
portfolio_summary: equal arithmetic mean of each fixed method's released AUC-PR; not an ensemble score or deployable selector
primary_unit: equal source-family means; source-family is a released grouping, not proof of native source independence
oracle_rule: per-series max, labels used, ORACLE_ENVELOPE only; exact positive/negative/tie
sentinel_rank: documented measured family first; lower prior selected-family count; robust margin descending (tie abs gap ascending, highD descending, duration descending); filename lexicographic
sentinel_constraints: unique file, no known exact-duplicate group repeated; seek >=4 families; do not relax thresholds to fill shortfall
unknown_source_policy: CreditCard family mapping/catalog conflict -> UNKNOWN_SOURCE; not counted as measured
zero_metric_policy: retain released zeros; distinguish missingness from zero; absent failure logs prevent attributing zero to execution failure
warmup_rule: known windows from inspected candidate HP dictionary; unknown ACF-derived window remains bounded/unknown; no fabricated AP sensitivity without raw scores
pareto_rule: maximize equal-family AUC-PR and equal-family median published throughput; separate ALL and CD subsets; publish arithmetic and harmonic aggregation sensitivity; LEAP batch/call units caveat
actionable_gate: >=3 families same material feature-contrast direction; all-family leave-one-out remains same direction; fixed-method/portfolio survives method and source checks; warmup/scoring artifacts ruled out by evidence; mechanism beyond selection. Missing causal artifact exclusion withholds PASS.
